adjudication_rule: Governance over protocol revenue is VA_GOV. VA_PROTOCOL additionally requires a live mechanical route by which value terminates at the token or holders through burn, buyback, distribution, or an equivalent holder-directed mechanism. Ecosystem grants and infrastructure spending alone do not qualify.

decisions.rationale: Solana permanently burns 50% of each transaction base fee.
Usage-linked base-fee burning provides a live automatic value-capture route.
Avalanche transaction fees are permanently burned.
Usage-linked transaction-fee burning provides a live automatic value-capture route.
The official economic model documents ongoing transaction-fee burning and a sustained deflationary trend predating the analysis window; the study conservatively dates verification from window start.
Resource shortfalls automatically burn TRX at governed fixed rates, linking network usage to token destruction.
Every applied XRP Ledger transaction irrevocably destroys its XRP transaction cost.
Usage-linked transaction-cost destruction provides a live automatic value-capture route.
Cardano transaction fees enter the epoch reward pot rather than being destroyed.

Ordinary proof-of-stake rewards are service compensation, while the governance treasury funds third-party projects and protocol infrastructure rather than mechanically burning, buying back, or distributing value to ADA holders. Governance authority remains VA_GOV, not VA_PROTOCOL.
